questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “AIoT and edge inference”?
options: HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
Quantization can reduce memory and compute, but accuracy must be measured again.
Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
questions.answer: Quantization can reduce memory and compute, but accuracy must be measured again.
questions.explanation:
Quantization can reduce memory and compute, but accuracy must be measured again.
Why: Edge inference runs on a device or gateway and may reduce sensitive raw-data transfer. Measure model size, RAM/flash, latency, energy, and error rates.
